objectives.statement: The browser build is served from the user's domain with the headers it needs
It works offline after the first visit
The existing site on that domain is unaffected and its own header gate passes unweakened

artifacts.note: versioned builds inside the target, relative current link renamed atomically
hosting rewritten around an origin of its own, block as deployed

evidence.claim: The site's header gate passes with the new server block
The new config is valid and serves the right types before touching production
evidence.method: nginx:1.27-alpine locally with the new nginx.conf and the build mounted; nginx -t; curl; smoke.py --url
evidence.result: syntax ok; wasm application/wasm, mjs application/javascript, manifest application/manifest+json, missing file 404; SMOKE OK

evidence.claim: Only the frontend container changed on the server
evidence.method: ops/deploy_frontend.sh on the box; docker compose ps
evidence.result: box f9c463c -> 4ecf721; frontend healthy; backend Up 12 days

evidence.claim: The DNS change added one record and altered nothing else
evidence.method: Cloudflare API reads before apply; cloudflare_dns.sh --apply
evidence.result: existing apex/www/app records and three settings already equal to the written values; CREATE A vibecoder ok

evidence.claim: The live site sends the needed headers
evidence.result: HTTP/2 200 via cloudflare; CSP with wasm-unsafe-eval; application/wasm 9598218 B; application/javascript for .mjs; no-cache; build fa8cb29f13036270

evidence.claim: The engine plays on the live site
evidence.result: boot 10313 ms cold, open 138 ms, run 127 ms, 5/5, ops 1364 = ref 1364, runaway -> Timeout

evidence.claim: It works offline after one visit
evidence.method: headless Chromium: visit, wait for the service worker's cache, set network offline, reload
evidence.result: 32 entries cached; campaign rendered offline in 3.7 s

evidence.method: curl https://astra-arcana.com/ and https://app.astra-arcana.com/ after the deploy
evidence.result: 200 and 200; landing CSP still without wasm-unsafe-eval

evidence.claim: A first visit on a phone network loads acceptably
evidence.result: cold boot measured only on a desktop connection (10.3 s)

misconceptions.believed: Serving at /vibecoder/ on the apex or at a subdomain were interchangeable
misconceptions.revealed_by: The site's nginx config documents a /-scoped service worker hazard, and its test_edge_headers demands verbatim header sets per server block, which a wasm-enabled location on the apex cannot meet without loosening the landing page
misconceptions.corrected_to: A subdomain, chosen by the user with that information
misconceptions.generalisable_lesson: Read the host's own invariants before offering a URL shape.

misconceptions.believed: Replacing the target path with a new symlink would redirect the running web server
misconceptions.revealed_by: Reading the compose file before the first deploy: the target is a Docker bind mount, resolved once at container start
misconceptions.corrected_to: Versioned builds inside the mount and a current link inside it, renamed atomically and resolved by nginx per request
misconceptions.generalisable_lesson: An atomic swap is only atomic for whoever resolves the name after it; find out who that is.

decisions.rationale: Passes the site's header gate unchanged and keeps the marketing page strict; the user approved

decisions.decision: Mount the build read-only into the existing frontend container, released by VibeCoder's own tool
alternatives: Bake the files into the astra-frontend image
decisions.rationale: Releases the game without rebuilding the site while the site's config and tests still govern how it is served

decisions.decision: Cache-Control no-cache for the whole game host
alternatives: Long-lived caching with content-hashed file names
decisions.rationale: File names are stable; the offline worker already makes repeat visits local

friction.description: The first firewall change allowed the server's own address instead of the build host's
The build host's resolver cached NXDOMAIN for the new name; checks pinned the Cloudflare address
zsh does not word-split an unquoted variable holding two curl flags

handoff.state: T9 W1-W5 landed; the game is live at https://vibecoder.astra-arcana.com, the APK is on the v0.2.0 release, the wheel awaits the user's PyPI upload.
handoff.next_action: A person plays the phone build: a level cleared by typing and a boss fought to the end, observations recorded (T9 W6).

open_questions.question: How is astra-arcana.com served, and from where is SSH allowed?
open_questions.answer: nginx inside the site's frontend container, config in astro_caster; SSH from an allow-listed source address

open_questions.question: Should the web build content-hash its file names so the CDN can cache them for long?
